options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone dies; when anyone dies, you die.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Win condition.

beat_game: reach Gamble Galaxy and claim the Strawberry Shortcake (beat the game).
chests_and_daroach: collect a set number of chests (chest_goal_count) AND beat
    Daroach, the Ice Island boss (the stage-6 boss).

options.name: Chest Goal Count
options.doc: For the chests_and_daroach goal: how many chests you must collect.

options.name: Ability Acquired Checks
options.doc:
Add a check for the first time you use each copy ability you've received.

Adds 23 ability-acquired locations (one per ability) and 23 more filler items
to match. Off = no ability-use checks.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoutez une vérification pour la première fois que vous utilisez chaque capacité de copie que vous avez reçue.

Ajoute 23 emplacements d'acquisition de capacités (un par capacité) et 23 autres articles de remplissage à correspondre. Arrêt = aucune vérification de l'utilisation des capacités.

options.name: Starting Spray
options.doc:
Which spray paint Kirby owns from the start. Granted directly -- no location check is
consumed for it.

Pink is Kirby's default and is always available. Choose a color to also OWN that spray from
the start (it shows in your collection and you can apply / re-apply it freely from the spray
menu). 'none' = Pink only. Set this to 'random' in your YAML to have Archipelago pick one for
you -- that's handled by AP itself, so there's no explicit 'random' option here.

Unlike the old Random Starting Color, this grants the real spray instead of a cosmetic tint,
so it sticks and doesn't fight the spray menu.
